beats.care: Scan a QR sticker for your ticket at stations like Esplanade or Sealdah, and don't push into a full train.
beats.what: Big Shashthi crowds hit the Metro. RPF teams, including women's squads, are deployed at 12 Blue Line stations from Oct 16 to 21.
beats.why: Packed trains and platforms are risky. Reports said crowds made it hard for doors to close at some stations.

cards.body: Esplanade, Dum Dum, Dakshineswar, Rabindra Sarobar, Mahanayak Uttam Kumar, Kalighat, Howrah, Sealdah, Sovabazar-Sutanuti, Salt Lake Sector V and Dum Dum Cantonment.
cards.caption: stations with QR-sticker tickets

opts: To stop people from falling or being pushed onto the tracks
To keep seats free for elders
cards.q: What's the main point of RPF staff keeping people behind the yellow line?
cards.why: The yellow line marks a safe gap from the platform edge, which matters most when crowds push forward.

cards.body: Women RPF teams, quick response teams and disaster teams are on stations and trains. Esplanade, Howrah, Howrah Maidan and Sealdah are under special watch, with live CCTV monitoring.
cards.title: Who's watching

hook: Can you buy a metro ticket *without any app* this Puja?

learn.t: At 11 Kolkata Metro stations you can buy a ticket by scanning a QR sticker with your phone, no app needed.

sources.name: The Statesman
sources.title: Kolkata Metro steps up security amid Durga Puja pandal-hopper rush

sources.name: Urban Acres (via Sangbad Pratidin)
sources.title: Kolkata Metro Crowding Triggers Door Failures During Puja

tldr: Metro got packed on Shashthi, so RPF teams now guard 12 busy Blue Line stations till Oct 21, and you can skip ticket queues using QR stickers at 11 stations.
watch: Metro says the QR-sticker ticketing will later reach other stations on all corridors.
